description: A placeholder passed to a STRICT function gives no reason to pass NULL, so a comparison elsewhere leaves it non-nullable

params.name: id
params.note: NULL would only make is_visible($1) NULL, filtering every row out

name: strict_function_argument
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE accounts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, hidden BOOLEAN NOT NULL);
CREATE FUNCTION is_visible(account integer) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE STRICT RETURN NOT (SELECT hidden FROM accounts WHERE id = account);
